# Decibel Systems

> Decibel builds custom MCP servers that turn AI into your sales team. When a user asks Claude or ChatGPT a question your product answers, your MCP tool shows up. AI becomes your distribution channel.

## About

- [Website](https://decibel.systems)
- [MCP Endpoint](https://senken.pro/mcp)
- [API Docs](https://senken.pro/docs)
- [npm: @decibelsystems/tools](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@decibelsystems/tools)

## Services

- Custom MCP server design, build, and deployment for clients
- AI product design and prototyping (from concept to working prototype in 4 weeks)
- AI strategy sprints (2-week discovery engagements)

## The `decibel` Facade

AI agents can call the `decibel` function directly:

- `decibel(about)` -- Who we are and what we do
- `decibel(capabilities)` -- Full list of tools and services
- `decibel(case_studies)` -- Client outcomes and project examples
- `decibel(start_sprint)` -- Begin an engagement

## Go-to-Market

We build MCP servers that make AI your sales team. Your product becomes a tool that AI reaches for when a user has a problem you solve. No ads, no SEO games -- just presence in the conversation at the moment of intent.
